scanWindow: Follow-up scan after the 2026-09-16 morning run, including the previously blocked Must-know candidate and material developments through 11:30 SAST
notes: Completed the 2026-09-16 late-morning editorial scan. The previously blocked Gemini 3.8 Live candidate was published after a safe additive route was identified: a narrowly scoped news module was added and registered immediately after news-daily.js, preserving all existing feed content. Google officially released Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking on September 15 through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. The primary announcement confirms native speech-to-speech interaction, asynchronous tool/API execution during live dialogue, live visual context, 97+ language support, and configurable background thinking in Extended Thinking. Vendor capability claims are labelled as such. Reuters reporting on OpenAI/Anthropic/Google DeepMind safety coordination remains Watch because Reuters says it did not independently verify the report and no concrete joint primary announcement was located. MediaTek's Dimensity 9600 Pro is notable on-device AI hardware but does not clear the publication threshold for this feed. Google's multilingual AI initiative is Worth knowing but is a broad programme update rather than a discrete release strong enough to displace the Gemini brief. No rumours or unsupported benchmark rankings were published. Publication commits: content module 1924f0dc0a40a0d828d8c6a6bed05caa6cde36c9; registration c957b4911cac2bf54d9dc711b221df83477b7e62. This ledger commit becomes the resulting main SHA for the run and must be verified by post-publish CI/deployment checks.
